changed.task_mixture_source: Seongsan choice, not a paper setting

previous_provenance.status: SUMO transfer combining published components; not an exact paper reproduction

ppo.transfer: Categorical joint acceleration/lane actions replace Gaussian robotics actions. The original T=2048 is used as a total update batch, split into 512-step segments across four workers; it is not 2048 steps per worker.

dynamics.source: Jiang 2023 Table 3: acceleration +3/-4, 50 km/h, length 5 m, front/back 50/10 m, lane duration 3 s; section 5.1 V2I 300 m, cycle 90 s. Isele 2018: dt .2 s, horizon 100 steps, rewards +1/-10. Zhu 2021 Table III: time objective -0.001, time weight 5, red base -0.25, red speed -0.02, overspeed -0.002.
dynamics.full_seconds: Existing course episode budget, not a paper driving parameter.

observations.neighbors: Ye 2020 section IV-B, 21 features for ego and four neighbors; relative positions/scales adapted to the local road.
observations.cross_traffic: Isele 2018 sequential-action grid, 5x11, forward 0..20 m, lateral +/-90 m, heading/speed/occupancy. Ego-relative frame is the transfer choice.
observations.signals: Jiang 2023 section 3.2 and Zhu 2021 Table I. Route-specific light, distance and time to green. Assumes V2I in 300 m. Explicit presence and yellow coding are transfer choices.
observations.route: Course connectivity plus selected route, stop/yield sign and own stopping history. These are Seongsan additions, not claimed as verbatim paper inputs.

reward.source: Isele 2018 section III: success +1 and collision -10. Zhu 2021 equations (24),(30): time component c_obj*c_time=-0.001*5 per second; red violation -0.25-0.02*v[m/s].
reward.transfer: The time component is integrated over dt. Red crossing terminates with Zhu's red-violation term, not the collision penalty. Other unsuccessful terminations receive no success bonus or extra penalty. Combining these components, terminal traffic-rule definitions and route task boundaries are transfer choices.
reward.full_route: Success +1 is issued after each cleared junction, reusing the single-intersection task on a route. This repetition is a transfer choice. Overspeed uses Zhu equation (25), coefficient -0.002 times excess m/s.
reward.excluded_candidates: Zhu's fuel, battery and missed-green branches are omitted; this is not its full HEV reward. No additional hand-tuned coefficients are introduced.

previous_provenance.actions: Isele sequential accelerate/coast/brake combined with Jiang left/keep/right. Cartesian 9-action discretization is local; numerical acceleration bounds and duration are Jiang values.
previous_provenance.lane_duration_semantics: Jiang's 3 s value is applied to the TraCI changeLane request duration (request persistence). SUMO's default lateral motion model is retained; this is not a reproduction of Jiang's 3 s lane-changing trajectory.
previous_provenance.control: speedMode=96, laneChangeMode=0; setSpeed(v+a*dt), physical bounds only; no automatic longitudinal safety filter. Lane commands only constrained by lane existence/junction geometry.
previous_provenance.implementation_choices: Adam and framework initialization follow the existing paper runner. Seed, training budget, reset sampling and scenario selection are recorded per run. Floating-point tolerances are implementation details.

framework_defaults.source: Existing runner / PyTorch defaults, not verified paper values
framework_defaults.initialization: torch.nn.Linear.reset_parameters (default Kaiming-uniform weights and uniform biases)
framework_defaults.critic: Separate Adam optimizer, mean squared error; no value clipping
framework_defaults.resume: Weights-only warm start; Adam state is reset at each training stage

previous_provenance.full_route: Original ego_loop edge sequence, departPos and arrivalPos 48.90476674674972 m, and arrivalLane 0 are loaded from seongsan.rou.xml. Starting lane is sampled among lanes connected to the next route edge. The 500 s budget is a course setting.
previous_provenance.signal_curriculum: Ego starts 5..50 m before the signal and finishes one vehicle length (5 m) along the outgoing edge. Static red/green episodes have Isele's 20 s horizon. Initial speed follows Zhu's U(0,v_limit), restricted to physically stoppable state pairs. Reset/goal and static-phase choices are local curriculum design, not the original experiments.
previous_provenance.junction_curriculum: Sample existing route junctions with the same inputs, start 5..50 m before them and finish 5 m on the outgoing edge. Natural signals, stop/merge rules, and background traffic. Warm-up U(150,300) s comes from Jiang section 5.1. Sampling route junctions is a local curriculum choice.
previous_provenance.stop_curriculum: In training only, alternate moving starts with Isele-style stopped starts one vehicle length before mandatory stop lines. Own stopping history includes the observed initial stop. This is a declared local curriculum; reward coefficients are unchanged. Junction training reuses live background until the route-file flow horizon; evaluation resets independently.
previous_provenance.stop_subgoal: First commanded full stop within one vehicle length of a mandatory stop line is a successful subtask (+1, same Isele success coefficient). It is rewarded once per node, requires requested speed zero, and is not awarded for blocked routes. Defining this additional subtask is Seongsan design, not a verbatim reward from Isele.
previous_provenance.stop_preview: Map control points are queried along the selected route up to the existing 50 m observation range, including signs beyond short connectors. Rule-violation detection still uses the actual node being crossed. This lookahead definition is Seongsan design; it supplies observations without controlling the car.
previous_provenance.mixed_curriculum: After full-route-only training showed signal regression, one of four workers is assigned to each of signal, mandatory-stop, local-junction and full-route tasks. Each contributes 512 transitions per 2048-step update. This equal task sampling and additional 500,000-step budget are Seongsan choices, not paper-prescribed parameters. Numerical reward coefficients and PPO settings remain fixed.
